verdict.rationale: Marqeta's JIT funding gateway documentation confirms the core capability: a developer-hosted endpoint receives funding/authorization requests and returns approve/decline decisions using custom business logic (marqeta-docs-4), and webhooks are described as real-time notifications sent to a developer-hosted endpoint (marqeta-docs-9, marqeta-docs-20). However, the evidence pack contains no documented time-budget/timeout window for the JIT funding response or explicit developer-configurable fallback behavior on timeout. Missing for 10: documented response time budget/SLA for the auth-stream endpoint, explicit timeout fallback configuration options, and independent confirmation of real-world latency handling.
